text:
eli roberts: FYI booking for a 1.5 day trip to Stockholm next month. Do we get full day per diem for travel days or pro-rated?
people-ops: Hi @eli roberts 50% rule applies: travel days <12 hours = half-day per diem; >=12 hours = full day. Overnight travel counts as full day for destination per diem rules.
eli roberts: Cool. If I arrive late on day 1 and dinner is company-provided, do I still claim per diem for that day?
people-ops: If a meal is provided by the company or event, deduct the meal from the per diem for that day. Note: you can still claim travel incidentals up to the per diem cap after deductions.
anna k: Quick one 50% — I lost a taxi receipt on a reimbursable layover. Any workaround?
people-ops: For lost receipts under $75 you can submit a Lost Receipt Attestation (form in handbook) plus transaction trace (card statement). For amounts >= $75 we need vendor copy or will require manager sign-off.
eli roberts: If I book outside the company portal to save money (cheaper fare on a third-party), will it be reimbursed?
people-ops: We prefer bookings via the corporate tool for duty of care. If you book outside, get preapproval from travel@redwood.com explaining savings. Reimbursement requires receipt and proof you chose the cheaper alternative. Non-refundable upgrades (seat, baggage) need preapproval on billed itinerary.
finance: Also note: personal card charges that exceed policy (e.g., premium upgrades without preapproval) may not be reimbursed without manager escalation.
eli roberts: One more: Sweden per diem cap?
people-ops: Sweden city cap is listed in the per diem schedule (in handbook). If your total meals exceed cap, reimbursements will be capped. For multi-city trips, per diem is calculated per overnight location.
travel-bot: Reminder: Per diem does not require meal receipts, but all non-per-diem purchases need itemized receipts. See https://intra.redwood/people-ops/per-diem-policy
anna k: Thanks 50 will fill the lost receipt attestation and preapprove external booking if needed.
people-ops: Thanks folks 50 ping travel@redwood.com with the itinerary if you want us to pre-clear exceptions.
